🚫 Blocked Dates & Days
🔒

This tool is for MIS/Director only.

📅 Add a Blocked Date

No leave can be approved on a blocked date — applications for that day will be auto-rejected.

🗓️ Block a Date Range

Block every date in a range at once — e.g. a week-long stock audit or store closure — instead of adding each day one by one.

🗓️ Blocked Weekdays

Toggle ON to block leave applications on that weekday every week (e.g. block Sundays).

⚙️ Settings
🔒

This page is for MIS/Director only.

👤 Select Employee

All access sections are always shown below. Pick an employee here to tick the boxes that already apply to them — everything else stays unticked. Tick/untick whatever you need, then save.

Loading...
🔑 Select Admin

All access sections are always shown below. Pick a non-MIS/Director admin here to tick the boxes that already apply to them — everything else stays unticked (Director shown separately as always-full-access; Director/EA/Manager/Store Manager/Asst Manager etc. all appear here individually — access is set per PERSON, not per job title).

Loading...
🎨 Theme

Pick a color theme for your own login (saved on this device).

🖼️ Store Logo

Upload once — this logo replaces the ✦ mark on the login page, topbar and sidebar everywhere, with no background box around it.

🖼️ Login Background Image

Optional — shows behind the login card instead of the plain purple. Pick an expiry date; once it passes, this is removed automatically and the login page goes back to the default purple theme on its own.

No background image set (login page shows the default purple theme).
⚙️ Required Fields Settings

Switch the ★ (compulsory) flag on/off for any field in any entry form — Stock Entry/Transfer, DSR, Outlet Issue, RDR, Leave, New Loyalty Card, Golden Aura, Lead Call Log. Off = that field is no longer blocked at Submit.

⏱️ Auto-Logout Timer

No activity (mouse/touch/keyboard) for this long auto-logs-out any Employee or Admin login on the portal.

🔍 Customer 360°

Search by mobile number, customer name, Loyalty Card No, Golden Plan No, or DSR ID to see every visit, Loyalty Card, Golden Aura plan, Lead call, and DSR purchase on record for them.

⚠️ Extra DSR Check

Compares each employee's own reported Walk-in purchase count against actual DSR entries for the same date. More DSR entries than reported purchases usually means an old, unbilled sale got entered under today's date by mistake. Informational only — this never affects KPI scoring.

Pick a date range and tap Check.
